purpose: Machine-readable contract for the witness-parametric iPRA formulation of Morley's trisector theorem.

scalar_representation.modulus: A monic square-free p in Z[X].
scalar_representation.selected_root: A rational interval plus a finite Sturm/Thom or signed-subresultant trace isolating one real root theta of p.
scalar_representation.scalar: A normalized pair (q,d), q in Z[X] reduced modulo p and d a positive integer, denoting q(theta)/d.
scalar_representation.equality: Cross-multiply denominators, reduce modulo p, and require the zero residue.
scalar_representation.cancellation: Every canceled factor has an explicit scalar inverse whose product normalizes to one.
scalar_representation.sign: Internal-branch claims carry independently checkable finite sign traces.

orientation.clockwise_normalization: Conjugate every rotation pair and use the counterclockwise equations.
